description: Is this claim true? Fact-check a single factual claim or statement against live web evidence before your agent relies on it. A fact-checking oracle, hallucination guard, and grounding and citation check for misinformation review: returns a verdict (supported / contradicted / insufficient), a confidence score, and source citations, as a signed attestation your agent can cite. Free tier is unsigned and rate-limited. For a cryptographically signed attestation with no daily limit ($0.25 USDC), add an x402 payment header to THIS SAME tool call (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for v2, X-PAYMENT for v1) or POST /verify/claim over HTTP. Same price on either transport.
name: verify_claim
